models.label: Joint EXOFASTv2 fit (two Keplerians: planet + activity)

datasets.note: 24 RVs used after excluding 16 Sep night

datasets.instrument: TESS camera (SPOC pipeline, PDC light curve)

datasets.bands: Tycho BT VT; Gaia G; 2MASS J, H, Ks; WISE W1-W4; TESS T
datasets.note: SED fit with Gaia DR2 parallax and V-band extinction limit

models.joint_description: RV (CORALIE + MINERVA-Australis), TESS transit light curves, SED photometry and Gaia parallax fit simultaneously in EXOFASTv2; stellar Teff and [Fe/H] priors from spectral analysis; stellar activity modelled as second Keplerian

priors.as_printed: Gaussian prior on log g from spectroscopic analysis
Gaussian prior on [Fe/H] from spectroscopic analysis
priors.source: Sect. 3.3, 'The parameters log g and [Fe/H] obtained from the spectroscopic analysis were used as Gaussian priors.'

priors.as_printed: Teff from SpecMatch-emp stacked spectrum used as prior
priors.source: Sect. 3.1, 'We adopted Teff, and [Fe/H] obtained for the stacked spectrum as priors for the global modelling.'

priors.as_printed: Gaia DR2 parallax used as Gaussian prior, adjusted by +0.07 mas
upper limit on V-band extinction from Schlegel et al. (1998) and Schlafly & Finkbeiner (2011)

assumptions.text: Stellar activity signal modelled as an additional Keplerian with period prior from spectral indicators
assumptions.quote: we model the stellar rotation as an additional Keplerian with a Gaussian prior on the period

assumptions.text: Gaia DR2 parallax offset corrected by +0.07 mas for systematics
assumptions.quote: we adjusted the parallax by $+0.07$ mas based on the systematic offsets

assumptions.text: Transit not grazing / single planet on eccentric orbit; no second planet detected
assumptions.quote: At the present time, our data show no significant evidence for the presence of a second planet

assumptions.text: Star treated as single; no bound stellar companion; no nearby contaminating eclipsing binary from NaCo imaging
assumptions.quote: The target appears to be single, to the limit of the imaging resolution.

assumptions.text: Model uses MIST isochrones; alternative Torres and YY isochrones gave no significant differences
assumptions.quote: We compared results using the Torres radius-mass relationship

models.quote: Simultaneous and self-consistent fitting of the CORALIE and MINERVA-Australis radial velocities, TESS transit light curves and stellar parameters was performed using EXOFASTv2
